summary: Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a $200 million best-efforts securities purchase agreement on July 29, 2026, issuing 20 million Class A ordinary shares at $10.00 per share. The offering was made under an effective F-1 shelf registration statement, with proceeds for AI computing development, working capital, and general corporate purposes. The shares are listed on Nasdaq under AGCC. This is a routine equity financing, not a special situation.
